# Lago API Reference (contracts, beta)

> Scoped entry point for agents implementing the Lago API: product catalog, rate cards, plans with phases, contracts, events, invoicing and payments.

- [API introduction](/v2/api-reference/intro.md): Base URLs, authentication, conventions and scope.
- [Cursor pagination](/v2/api-reference/pagination.md)
- [Expansions](/v2/api-reference/expansions.md)
- [Structured errors](/v2/api-reference/errors.md)
- [Rate limits](/api-reference/rate-limits.md)
- [Versioning and deprecation](/api-reference/versioning.md)
- [Complete OpenAPI specification](https://swagger.getlago.com/openapi-v2.yaml)
- [Contracts vs subscriptions](/v2/guide/introduction/contracts-vs-subscriptions.md)
- [Your first invoice](/v2/guide/introduction/your-first-invoice.md)

Base URLs: `https://api.getlago.com/api/v2` (US) and `https://api.eu.getlago.com/api/v2` (EU). Authenticate with an organization API key in the `Authorization: Bearer` header and keep keys server-side. Request bodies are wrapped in the resource key, for example `{"contract": {...}}`. Events for a contract use `external_contract_id`. API v2 documents only its native endpoints; use the [v1 reference](/api-reference/intro.md) for subscriptions. Verify the target organization, environment, identifiers, currency, amount and effective date before any billing mutation.
